svg.text: Raspberry Pi 5 · PREEMPT_RT · Behringer UMC202HD (USB 2.0, class-compliant, 44.1-192 kHz) · fs and period size set by the ALSA negotiation: 96 kHz, 48-frame periods, 96 as fallback (VERIFY against the device)
output-path latency ≈ 6-8 ms (audiod ≈ 1 ms + USB/converters; unverified planning range, §4 — VERIFY via loopback) · analysis is a slow closed loop (seconds) and never delays audio
restart on hang or crash · every daemon sends WATCHDOG=1 back to systemd every 5 s
time-gated poll of the mmap hw ptr (B) · per 48-frame period:
→ DAC (same mono signal on L and R)
→ push raw L/R to ring · update status block
mute gate MUTED → FADING_IN → LIVE (zeros while muted)
no malloc · no blocking syscalls · no logging
WATCHDOG=1 every 5 s, only if the heartbeat advanced
never calls alsa-lib on the RT thread's handles
/dev/shm · audiod creates, others attach · never unlinked
our graded intelligence: no models, no cloud
GCC-PHAT delay, Source vs mic (10–100 ms)
inverse mic curve · trusts 100 Hz–8 kHz
gates: level · coherence · Δ · cuts over boosts
control plane: presets · limits · bypass · meters
sole producer of the param triple buffer
bypass/limits work even if analyzerd is down
LAN web interface; talks only to ctld
kernel space · PREEMPT_RT 6.12+ · isolcpus=3 nohz_full=3 rcu_nocbs=3 · all IRQs (incl. xHCI) on cores 0-1, none on core 3 · irqbalance off · governor = performance
in: LAN subnet → UI port + key-only SSH
out: everything dropped (no DNS / NTP / mDNS)
class-compliant USB 2.0 · MIDAS preamps · bus-powered · +48V: OFF
Input 1 (combo XLR/TRS): line = Source ← mixing desk
Input 2 (combo XLR/TRS): mic preamp ≈ 50-60 dB = System ← dynamic mic (needs no +48V)
Output L/R (balanced 1/4" TRS, not XLR) → TRS→XLR adapters → PA / speakers
internal ADC/DAC share one clock — Source/System stay sample-aligned
implicit feedback: playback follows capture's clock, so capture starts first
the actuator: output is hot path, not optional
Letters mark the Section 3.2 mechanisms we use: B, C, E, F.
No (A): stock ALSA/usb-audio driver, no custom overlay needed.
Known Linux quirk: one-time "clock source N is not valid" dmesg
line at probe (UMC-series). Fixed upstream ~5.19, so closed by
the 6.12+ RT kernel; listed for completeness only.
Removed vs. the custom-board design: THAT1246, THAT1512,
PCM1808, PCM5102A, DRV134 ×2, 24.576 MHz osc, Traco ±12 V,
MCP1700-3.3 — all folded into the off-the-shelf interface.
dev box: make deploy over SSH
teal = value agreed in the rate review
Rates on every arrow (fs = 96 kHz target — VERIFY against the USB interface)

g.text: USB interface's internal ADC/DAC clock (shared inside the box)
fixed by the hardware, not Pi-configurable
Pi ↔ USB interface enumeration (USB Audio Class 2.0)
USB interface → Pi, capture (L = Source, R = System)
USB isochronous IN · 96 kHz target (VERIFY against interface)
Pi → USB interface, playback (mono on L + R)
USB isochronous OUT · same rate as capture (implicit feedback)
USB host controller ↔ ALSA mmap buffer ↔ audiod
48-frame periods × 2-period buffer (96 fallback) · VERIFY round-trip via loopback
USB completion IRQ (xHCI, cores 0-1) updates hw ptr; audiod polls it (B)
rate set by period size; VERIFY in /proc/interrupts
target: 48 frames = 0.5 ms · 2000 periods/s (96 frames · 1000 periods/s fallback; sets every rate below)
audiod → SPSC ring (float32, 2¹⁷ frames = 1 MiB ≈ 1.37 s)
≈ 11.7 analyses/s · reader drops + counts on overrun
analyzerd → coeff triple buffer (19 × ⅓-oct biquads, float64)
ctld → param triple buffer (bypass, limits, presets, dynamics)
audiod loads both triple-buffer indices; ramps over 1 period
audiod → meter/status block (peaks, GR, xruns, heartbeat, mute state)
status block → ctld → AF_UNIX socket → ui
WebSocket push 20 Hz, a few KB/s · control requests at human rate
every 5 s (WatchdogSec=10); audiod only if its heartbeat advanced
on crash, missed watchdog or a restartable exit code; StartLimitBurst caps storms
event-driven (xruns etc.), target 0 during the 48 h soak
audiod → ALSA playback buffer (silence, software mute)
on events: zeros while muted, silence at teardown, no GPIO
inbound from LAN subnet only · all egress dropped · SSH only for make deploy
